```json
 "rationale": "A StrongARM draws no static current, so energy is switched capacitance times VDD^2. At 1.98 V the 210 fJ budget allows about 50 fF, which means short-channel, modest-width devices. Delay is set by the latch gm/C regeneration and the input-pair integration. A tail of W=3 um sized for ss/125C/1.62 V gives a 0.9 V input overdrive of roughly 0.25 V. The pfet latch has a high Vth, so the nfet latch provides most of the gm. Four PMOS resets equalise all nodes."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "Wtail": (3.0, 1.0, 8.0),    # tail switch width (um), L=0.15
    "Win":   (4.0, 1.0, 10.0),   # input pair width (um)
    "Wln":   (1.5, 0.5, 4.0),    # latch nfet width
    "Wlp":   (2.0, 0.6, 6.0),    # latch pfet width
    "Wrst":  (0.8, 0.42, 2.0),   # reset pfet width
    "Winv":  (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),   # output inverter nfet width (pfet = 2x)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    L = 0.15
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")

    # tail switch
    n.M("MT", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wtail"], L)
    # input pair: vinp side drains node dip (falls faster when vinp>vinn)
    n.M("M1", "dip", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["Win"], L)
    n.M("M2", "din", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["Win"], L)
    # cross-coupled latch: lp above dip, ln above din
    n.M("M3", "lp", "ln", "dip", "vss", "nfet", p["Wln"], L)
    n.M("M4", "ln", "lp", "din", "vss", "nfet", p["Wln"], L)
    n.M("M5", "lp", "ln", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wlp"], L)
    n.M("M6", "ln", "lp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wlp"], L)
    # reset switches (clk low -> precharge all to VDD)
    n.M("MR1", "lp", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wrst"], L)
    n.M("MR2", "ln", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wrst"], L)
    n.M("MR3", "dip", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wrst"], L)
    n.M("MR4", "din", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wrst"], L)
    # output inverters: lp falls when vinp>vinn -> outp high
    Wi, Wip = p["Winv"], 2.0 * p["Winv"]
    n.M("MI1", "outp", "lp", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wi, L)
    n.M("MI2", "outp", "lp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wip, L)
    n.M("MI3", "outn", "ln", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wi, L)
    n.M("MI4", "outn", "ln", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wip, L)

    # ---------- first-order predictions (worst case ss/125C) ----------
    cpf = 1.5e-15  # ~F per um of gate/junction width (short-channel)
    try:
        lw = lut.at("ss", 125)
    except Exception:
        lw = lut
    it = lw.op("n", p["Wtail"], L, 1.62, 0.3)["Id"]
    gin = lw.op("n", p["Win"], L, 0.9 - 0.2, 0.5)["gm"]
    gln = lw.op("n", p["Wln"], L, 0.8, 0.8)["gm"]
    glp = lw.op("p", p["Wlp"], L, 0.8, 0.8)["gm"]
    c_di = cpf * (p["Win"] + p["Wln"] + p["Wrst"])
    c_l = cpf * (p["Wln"] + p["Wlp"] + p["Wrst"]) * 2 + cpf * (Wi + Wip)
    c_out = cl + cpf * (Wi + Wip)
    # integration phase: discharge di nodes by ~Vthn, then the latch nodes by ~Vthp
    t_int = (2 * c_di * 0.7 + 2 * c_l * 0.4) / max(it, 1e-6)
    # input-referred gain at latch start
    av = max(gin * 0.4 / max(it / 2, 1e-7), 2.0)
    tau = c_l / max(gln + glp, 1e-6)
    t_reg = tau * math.log(vdd / (av * dv))
    t_inv = 0.69 * c_out * vdd / max(lw.op("p", Wip, L, 1.62, 0.9)["Id"], 1e-6)
    delay = t_int + t_reg + t_inv
    vmax = 1.98
    csw = 2 * c_di + 2 * c_l + c_out + cpf * (p["Wtail"] + 4 * p["Wrst"])
    energy = csw * vmax ** 2
    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
```
